description: 低饱和藏蓝与古金，克制的编辑插画，配合 academic-paper。

typography.heading: 手写风中文字体(类似 楷体 / Kalam)

prompt_template.newspic_card: Generate a hand-drawn sketch style infographic card in Chinese, 1:1 square. Pure white background. Theme: '{card_main}'. Draw with clean hand-drawn lines in navy (#2e3a5e), use blue (#4a6cf7) as the primary accent color, orange (#ff8c42) as secondary accent. Include Chinese labels using hand-written-style font. Visual elements: arrows, boxes, circles, simple icons, annotation marks. Minimalist tech-illustration feel, like a developer's notebook sketch. No photos, no 3D rendering, no gradients, no dark backgrounds.
prompt_template.article_inline: Academic editorial illustration about '{image_subject}', 1792x1024 landscape. Muted navy and antique gold on warm paper. Restrained composition with clear causal relationships. No decorative elements, logos, pseudo-text or invented numerical charts.

notes: 默认 1792×1024 PNG；封面另裁成 16:9。避免伪文字、装饰图标和无法核验的图表。
